Definition
[codifferential and normalized tensor inner product]

Source: petersen:page-0349 ↗ def:pet-ch9-de-rham-cohomology On a Riemannian manifold, the codifferential $\delta ^k:\Omega ^{k+1}(M)\to \Omega ^k(M)$ is the adjoint $\nabla ^*$ of $d^k$; equivalently, \[ \int _Mg(\delta ^k\omega _1,\omega _2)\, \mathrm{vol}=\int _Mg(\omega _1,d^k\omega _2)\, \mathrm{vol}. \] For fixed-type tensors, use the normalized pairing \[ (T_1,T_2)=\frac1{\operatorname {vol}M} \int _M g(T_1,T_2)\, \mathrm{vol}. \] The operators $d$ and $\delta $ remain adjoint for this normalization.
